title: ComfyUI_SenseNova_U1 Custom Nodes for Multimodal Models
summary: A set of custom nodes for ComfyUI enabling interaction with SenseTime's SenseNova U1 native unified multimodal models. It supports high-speed generation using 8-step LoRA and GGUF quantization for consumer-grade hardware.
research_notes: The 8B model can run on 8GB VRAM using Q6_K GGUF quantization but requires significant system RAM for optimal performance.

evolution.summary: SenseNova U1 marks the transition to the NEO-Unify architecture, which eliminates traditional VAEs and visual encoders for a native multimodal fusion. It succeeds the SenseNova 6.5 and MARS models, focusing on interleaved image-text reasoning.
